usageNotes: Use this to list all VNets (virtual networks) provisioned within a specific SDN zone on a given node, along with each VNet's runtime status and any status detail message. The querying node must be online and have the SDN subsystem active; results reflect that node's local view of the zone, so query the node that is expected to be running the zone's bridges. Requires SDN.Audit privilege on /sdn/zones/{zone}.

examples.summary: List VNets in the 'prod01' SDN zone as seen from node 'pve1'

tips: Zone names are 2–8 characters and must match [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*[a-zA-Z0-9]; verify the zone identifier against /cluster/sdn/zones before calling.
The 'status' and 'statusmsg' fields are optional in each returned item; a missing status typically means the VNet has not yet been applied/deployed on that node.
SDN changes must be applied (via the SDN apply operation) before new VNets appear with an 'ok' status here.
